claim: Apple specifies that keyboards made for Windows PCs function on Mac by substituting the Alt key for Option and the Windows logo key or Ctrl key for Command.
excerpt: On keyboards made for Windows PCs, press the Alt key instead of Option, and the Ctrl key or Windows logo key instead of Command.

claim: Apple documentation confirms Windows keyboards map Alt to Option and Control to Command for standard shortcuts like copy or save.

source.title: Windows keys on a Mac keyboard - Apple Support

excerpt: Swap in Command for Control for many common shortcuts used on a Windows PC. For example, press Command-C to copy or Command-S to save a document or file.

claim: USB HID Usage Tables define Keyboard Left Alt as usage ID 0xE2 and Keyboard Left GUI as usage ID 0xE3.
excerpt:
#define KEY_LEFTALT 0xe2 // Keyboard Left Alt
#define KEY_LEFTMETA 0xe3 // Keyboard Left GUI

claim: Apple hardware technical specifications define standard Mac keyboards with 78 US or 79 ISO keys including 4 arrow keys arranged in an inverted-T layout.
excerpt: Backlit Magic Keyboard with: 78 (U.S.) or 79 (ISO) keys including 12 full-height function keys and 4 arrow keys in an inverted‑T arrangement.

claim: Custom mechanical keyboards maintain standard 1u full-height keycaps for inverted-T arrow clusters while Apple Magic Keyboards use low-profile keycaps.
excerpt: I kinda like keeping the Command key a bit larger than the Alt/Option key because that's how most Mac keyboards are. The different sizes of the modifiers

claim: Apple keyboards map Fn key combinations with directional arrows to emulate dedicated navigation keys like Page Up, Page Down, Home, and End.
excerpt: Fn–Up Arrow: Page Up: Scroll up one page. Fn–Down Arrow: Page Down: Scroll down one page. Fn–Left Arrow: Home: Scroll to the beginning of a document. Fn–Right Arrow: End: Scroll to the end of a document.
extracted: fn_up = page_up; fn_down = page_down; fn_left = home; fn_right = end

claim: On Mac keyboards, pressing Fn and Delete performs a forward delete operation equivalent to the PC Delete key.

source.title: Windows keys on a Mac keyboard - Apple Support

excerpt: Press Delete to delete the character to the left of the insertion point. Press Fn–Delete to delete the character to the right of the insertion point.

claim: Mac keyboards omit a physical Context Menu key and rely instead on Control-click or multi-touch gestures to trigger contextual menus.

source.title: Map the application key to right-click at caret position - Ask Different

excerpt: How do I open the context menu from a Mac keyboard?

claim: QMK firmware includes the MAGIC_SWAP_ALT_GUI keycode to swap Left Alt and Left GUI logical roles on both sides of the keyboard without modifying PCB traces.
excerpt: MAGIC_SWAP_ALT_GUI, AG_SWAP, Swap Alt and GUI on both sides

claim: QMK firmware provides CG_TOGG keycode to toggle the logical swap of Control and GUI modifier keys.
excerpt: CG_TOGG, Toggle Ctrl and GUI swap on both sides.

claim: Apple introduced an OLED Touch Bar replacing the physical function key row in 2016 MacBook Pro models before restoring physical function keys in 2021.

source.title: Touch Bar Fully Discontinued on New MacBooks After Seven Years

excerpt: In 2021, Apple removed the Touch Bar from higher-end MacBook Pro models, switching back to full-size physical function keys.

claim: Apple keyboards feature a Power button or Touch ID sensor in the top-right position of the function row to wake, sleep, or turn off the Mac.
excerpt: Power button: Press to turn on your Mac or wake it from sleep. Press and hold to force your Mac to turn off, such as when your Mac isn’t responding
